_doc: Verdict registry for config.extensions passthrough cases (the 2026-09-01
whose canonical_request carries non-empty config.extensions MUST appear
in exactly one bucket below — tools/audit.py enforces this as a HARD
violation. Promoted concepts appear in no bucket: their cases were
rewritten onto canonical fields and no longer carry extensions.
The value names the reason a canonical spelling would be fake
portability. Adding an entry is an additive spec change (changes/).
deferred: real cross-provider concepts DELIBERATELY awaiting their own
design pass. The value names the pass. These are still debt — the
registry makes the deferral explicit instead of silent.

blessed.anthropic.thinking: INV-049: thinking display selector — no other provider exposes one
blessed.anthropic.thinking_budget: INV-049: thinking display selector — no other provider exposes one
blessed.openai.max_tool_calls: INV-049: per-response tool-invocation cap — no canonical loop-budget concept
blessed.openai.code_interpreter: INV-049: include tunes provider-executed tool trace verbosity (MAP-1 keeps those out of canonical parts)
blessed.gemini.safety_settings: INV-049: request-side safety threshold dial — OpenAI/Anthropic expose no equivalent wire field
blessed.anthropic.inference_geo: INV-049: data-residency routing preference — Anthropic-only wire field
blessed.openai.metadata: INV-049: free-form request tags tied to OpenAI's stored-response dashboard; Anthropic's metadata carries ONLY user_id (a different concept, promoted to Config.user_id)
blessed.openai.user: INV-049: legacy end-user spelling DEPRECATED by OpenAI in favor of safety_identifier (promoted as Config.user_id); kept as the passthrough MECHANISM's own pinned exemplar — the escape hatch needs one case proving arbitrary keys flow verbatim
blessed.openai.previous_response_id: INV-049: OpenAI server-side response-state machinery; the canonical conversation model deliberately resends the transcript
blessed.openai.conversation: INV-049: OpenAI server-side response-state machinery; the canonical conversation model deliberately resends the transcript
blessed.openai.background: INV-049: OpenAI server-side response-state machinery (async stored responses); the job-shaped canonical concept is batch
blessed.openai.truncation: INV-049: OpenAI server-side context-truncation policy for stored-state conversations
blessed.openai.context_management: INV-049: OpenAI server-side context compaction config for stored-state conversations
blessed.openai.stream_options: INV-049: OpenAI stream-frame mechanics (obfuscation padding) — transport detail, not canonical semantics
blessed.openai.reasoning_encrypted: INV-049: encrypted reasoning passthrough for OpenAI's stateless replay of stored-state reasoning

deferred.openai.top_logprobs: logprobs design pass — cross-provider concept (Gemini responseLogprobs) blocked on a canonical OUTPUT surface for token probabilities
deferred.openai.include: logprobs design pass — same knobs as openai.top_logprobs (duplicate coverage; fold or drop when the pass lands)
deferred.openai.file_search: builtin-tool-forcing design pass — ToolChoice cannot yet express 'force this builtin'; each provider forces builtins differently
